Producer surplus is the ratio of the market price to the minimum producers will accept for a good/service.

CS + PS = Economic Surplus. Market prices are most directly influenced by demand, not supply.

Since a judge will know this, the effects on safety will be considered while processing a warrant, and we would avoid situations like having a few IMSI catchers roaming around the city causing dropped calls and interfering with emergency communications all the time; such inconvenience and hazard would be maintained within a statistically reasonable frequency.

I get it, police work is hard. There's so much going on that your cases just pile up and you start itching for a magic bullet for clearing up some crimes and solving some mysteries. Just because you can, doesn't mean you should. Dragging these things all over town affects everyone around your fancy toy, interrupting calls and data links, logging each of our devices' locations whether we're suspected of a crime or part of any investigation at all, and the really expensive ones will have us transmitting data over unencrypted airwaves. Don't try to tell me those higher models can't do SSL stripping just as easily as a corporate content filter, which means even the stuff we think is end-to-end encrypted through HTTPS is also being put on display for their perusal.
